features: EFFICIENT PERFORMANCE: Powered by the Intel Celeron N4500 processor. Engineered for smooth multitasking, student workloads, and daily office productivity.
EXPANSIVE VISUALS: Features a 15.6-inch (39.62 cm) High-Definition (HD) display with narrow bezels, delivering clear and vibrant imagery for work and entertainment.
HIGH-SPEED STORAGE: Equipped with 8GB LPDDR4 RAM and a 256GB SSD. Ensures lightning-fast boot times and quick access to all your essential files.
MODERN CONNECTIVITY: Stay connected with 802.11ac Wi-Fi and Bluetooth. Includes multiple USB ports and an HDMI port for full peripheral compatibility.
THIN & LIGHT DESIGN: Finished in a premium Pure Silver, this portable notebook weighs only 1.7 kg, making it perfect for professionals and students on the go.
description: The Acer Aspire 3 A325-45 is designed for practical, everyday computing. Powered by the Intel Celeron N4500 processor and 8GB of high-speed memory, it provides the reliability needed for documents, web browsing, and video calls. The 15.6" HD display offers a crisp viewing experience, while the 256GB SSD ensures your system remains responsive. With its sleek Pure Silver chassis and lightweight build, it is the ideal companion for your mobile lifestyle. Pre-installed with Windows 11 Home SL for a modern user experience.
